name: Discord bot
description: Posts joins, leaves and server up/down to a Discord channel, and answers /status, /players and /leaderboard slash commands.
author: Console
permissions: Sends messages to your Discord webhook
Reads server status and player stats

settings.label: Channel webhook URL
settings.help: Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL. Enough for join/leave/status posts.

settings.label: Post when the server goes up or down
Public key (for slash commands)
settings.help: Same page. Then set Interactions Endpoint URL to https://YOUR-PANEL/x/discord-bot/interactions

settings.label: Bot token (only to register the commands)
settings.help: Bot tab → Reset Token. Used once to create /status, /players and /leaderboard.
